provider_approval_type: curriculum approval by the Department of Human Services
enforcing_agencies: Local Government or Law Enforcement Agency
applicable_to: lodging establishments (hotel or motel under NAICS codes 721110 and 721120)
restaurants (primary engaged in selling ready-to-eat food for immediate consumption, comprising at least 51% of total sales)
truck stops (providing services to the trucking industry)
required_topics: definition of human trafficking and commercial exploitation of children
identification of individuals at risk for human trafficking
differences between labor and sex trafficking in the context of lodging establishments, restaurants, and truck stops
role of employees in reporting and responding to instances of human trafficking
risks_or_constraints: potential for fines up to $1,500 per offense
